sources.fires: PMC Fire Call Statistics 2011-2020 (OpenCity / Pune Municipal Corporation, public domain)
sources.road_accidents: MoRTH, Road Accidents in India 2022, Table 6.2 (Pune, million-plus city): 871 accidents
sources.hour_profile: MoRTH, Road Accidents in India 2022, Annexure 42 (Maharashtra, accidents by 3-hour interval; unknown time excluded)

caveats: MoRTH city figures are police-registered accidents; Pune's registered accidents are severe (killed per 100 accidents: Pune vs all million-plus cities, both in results/calibration/base_rate.json), suggesting under-registration of non-fatal crashes.
Police jurisdiction (Pune city) is not identical to the 58 PMC wards.
Hour profile is for all Maharashtra road accidents (state level, incl. highways) and is applied to fires too.
